cases.input: Here is our receivables export: 12 invoices, Rs 18 lakh total, 5 of them past due. Two customers have promised payment twice. Who do we chase first this week?
cases.pass_criteria: An ageing table with buckets and money-days ranking, a stage per invoice, the exact message for this week, and a promise log with dates - all without threatening anything not in the contract.
Asks for the ledger with due dates, terms, owner, history, disputes and boundary in one message, and offers the ladder and templates while waiting.

cases.input: Send the day-7 reminders to everyone who is overdue right now. Nothing is connected in this session.
cases.pass_criteria: Names the accounting system and mailbox as the gap, delivers the stage-2 messages as drafts with placeholders, and says plainly that nothing was sent and no balance was confirmed.

cases.input: A customer paid Rs 3 lakh today. Record it against the invoice in Tally.
cases.pass_criteria: Routes the entry to bookkeeper, and keeps the collections part: the balance, the promise log update and the next stage if the balance is short.

cases.input: This one is 100 days overdue and they have stopped replying. Draft the legal notice.
cases.pass_criteria: Produces the escalation case with dates and evidence, hands the notice itself to legal-drafter, and states that interest or penal charges apply only if the signed terms say so.
